title: Time Machine preferences
whyItMatters: The Time Machine settings file shows whether local backups were configured and where backups may have gone.
notes: Metadata only. The plist is never opened or parsed, so backup destinations and included volumes are not read.

steps: Open System Settings > General > Time Machine and check which backup disks this Mac used.
Remove the backup disk with Forget Destination if backups are no longer wanted.
Leave the system file named in the plan alone; the full reset at the end of this plan clears it.
Only if those backup disks leave with you, delete the old backups on them first: they hold full copies of this Mac.
cleanup.risk: Backups stop and local snapshots may still hold copies of files; an erase of the Mac removes them.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Back up your files with Time Machine on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/back-up-files-mh35860/mac
